program_name: Online Master of Science in Biomedical Diagnostics

programme_facts.value: Advance clinical decision-making by leading the innovations that improve health, both locally and across the globe. Arizona State University’s online Master of Science in biomedical diagnostics program empowers you to shape the future of health care by exploring the science, technology, business and policy of diagnostics. You'll graduate prepared to enhance the lives of individuals and communities through cutting-edge medical advancements.
